clips.title: Make Me a Bento to Call It Even
grammar: 〜てくれる — doing something for someone

lines.ja: 明日から君は俺にお弁当を作ってくれ。
lines.en: Starting tomorrow, you make me a bento lunch.
lines.speaker: Male Lead

lines.ja: なんで赤の他人のあなたに
lines.en: Why should I, for a complete stranger like you,
lines.speaker: Female Lead

lines.ja: お弁当を作ってあげなきゃいけないんですか？
lines.en: have to make you a bento?
lines.speaker: Female Lead

lines.ja: 見ず知らずの二人がお弁当をきっかけに…
lines.en: Two strangers, sparked by a bento box...
lines.speaker: Narrator
